title: Training to be a contractor and the ladder accident that led to music
summary: His father wanted him to be a plastering contractor; a broken ladder rung sprained his back and he turned to playing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You said once that you had been playing the instrument, but you hadn't thought about becoming a musician, which is a
very different thing. How did that happen with you? players

Well, I was going to be a (?) contractor. That's what my father wanted me to be. So he had to start from the bottom. And from the bottom meant that you had to mix the sand and the mortar and stuff together. Then you had to carry it. And in those days they had laddering(?), like foot(?) ladder(?) stuff -- you had to learn that.

And I was carrying some mortar up on a scaffold, and the ladder...the rung on the ladder under my foot broke, with all this powder mixture on me, and it bent me backwards double nearly. I hurt my back; I sprained my back. Therefore, I couldn't do that any more. So I had to start...I started playing. Not very good at first, but... Still not very good.
